clips.title: Mordida
clips.story: A heavy forward BITE. Frame 1 ready stance. Frame 2 shoulders lower and head retracts, elbows flex. Frame 3 neck coils, jaw opens very wide with upper and lower teeth separated. Frame 4 rear legs push and front paws reach forward, neck shoots forward and DOWN, open maw elongated towards left. Frame 5 JAWS SLAM CLOSED into a narrow toothed seam, head thrust maximally forward, rear foot planted hard, crown tilted and towers lag behind. Frame 6 jaw stays closed, body recoils, front knees buckle to absorb weight. Frame 7 raises head and shifts weight back, jaw partially opens. Frame 8 returns to the precise ready stance of frame 1. Essential: frame 5 mouth is CLOSED, not the same circular open portal as frame 1.
clips.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a production-oriented PIXEL ART ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for the creature in the reference. Reference is character identity/design only: AZHOR is a quadrupedal armored cosmic leviathan with a cathedral city growing on its back, silver-blue armor, gold edges, huge portal maw, antler-like golden orbital halo, curled armored tail. Maintain same anatomy, proportions, number of limbs, colors, design and viewing angle in every frame. Face LEFT throughout. Fixed three-quarter side camera, NO camera rotation. Simplify tiny city detail into coherent pixel clusters, preserve recognizable towers, halo and silhouette. TRUE whole-pose redraws in each cell: bend joints, articulate toes, reconstruct changed mouth anatomy and compressed/extended neck, deform the back/city silhouette with secondary action. This is NOT a rotated/scaled identical cutout in every cell. Dramatically distinct readable key poses with anticipation, contact and recovery. Crisp stepped pixel clusters, no blur, no interpolation smears, no smooth painted shading. Restrained ramps. Light from upper left. Transparent background.
LAYOUT CRITICAL: exactly FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS and TWO EQUAL ROWS, exactly EIGHT distinct frames in left-to-right then top-to-bottom reading order. Landscape canvas aspect 8:3, each cell aspect 4:3. Same spatial scale and SAME FLOOR BASELINE at 85% of every cell. Each complete creature fits safely inside its own cell with a 10% transparent gutter on all sides; no overlap between frames, no extra rows, no text, no grid lines, no numbering, no background, no ground platforms. Subtle pixel particles only where specified. Entire body and all limbs always visible; no clipping.

clips.title: Pisão sísmico
clips.story: A massive foreleg STOMP. 1 ready. 2 shifts weight to rear legs, head lowers. 3 lifts front foreleg HIGH with elbow fully bent and underside of foot visible. 4 rises higher with that leg nearly vertical above shoulder, torso twists slightly without camera change, city leaning back. 5 plants lifted paw violently, elbow straight, body crouched LOW, impact cracks/small stone chips beneath paw only. 6 deep compressed follow-through, neighboring legs bent and head dips. 7 pushes up, planted toes splayed, settles towers. 8 original ready pose. Draw real bent and extended leg anatomy; don't translate the whole body.

Make body recoil and mouth anatomy materially different.

Draw obvious transformed tower geometry and asymmetrical firing poses. Keep every projectile inside cell.

clips.title: Morte · queda da cidade
clips.story: DEATH sequence; do NOT return to ready stance. 1 standing but unstable with dim portal. 2 forelegs buckle inwards and head drops, cathedral cracks. 3 falls onto front knees, mouth loses its glowing core, central spire tilts physically and breaks near base. 4 rolls/slumps down on its LEFT flank, legs collapse at articulated joints, towers fall sideways in recognizable large pieces. 5 heavy body hits ground on its side, forelimbs folded awkwardly, broken spires hit beside body, orbital crown drops in front. 6 body settles as wrecked blue-silver armor, crushed city and limp uncoiled tail, a few gold dust pixels. 7 lifeless rubble corpse, mouth dark, no glows, no sparks, retain beast silhouette. 8 same final lifeless corpse held, tiny debris settles. Last frame much LOWER and wider than initial, recognizable fallen city and armored carcass; no disappearing, no standing torso.
